incident.symptom: Two personal LinkedIn posts reused the same car/sliding-door/airco anecdote with different wording.

root_cause: Historical duplicate detection over-relied on exact/story fingerprints and Jaccard similarity; a longer rewrite diluted Jaccard even while a large fraction of the smaller story was reused.
fix: Add a keyword overlap-coefficient gate and a database trigger backstop before any social provider write.
prevention: All current and future chats/agents/schedulers/connectors inherit the same database gate.
User-reported semantic duplicates become permanent regression cases.
Daily idempotency is not historical uniqueness.
Application-layer wording changes may never bypass canonical database history.
problem: A rewritten personal LinkedIn anecdote reused the same car/sliding-door/airco story and escaped the historical uniqueness gate.
